scope: Applies literature-review fields to the currently generated CPOSS CBZ/IBP evidence workpack without promoting any candidate into the benchmark.
global_review_notes: The current local CPOSS workpack has been expanded beyond the first 20-entry milestone by adding ACR and FLU MACE family measurements to the CBZ/IBP bridge.
The overlay fills citation, license, disorder, curator, reviewer, and promotion-decision fields where a family-level literature source exists.
No entry is promoted because the current workpack still lacks a locked mapping from every CPOSS block ID to an experimentally verified form label and stability condition.
